# from tvm.script import tir as T

@T.prim_func
def scrc_k0(p0_handle: T.handle, p1_handle: T.handle, p2_handle: T.handle, p3_handle: T.handle):
    x0 = T.int32()
    p0 = T.match_buffer(p0_handle, (x0, 16), strides=(16, 1))
    p1 = T.match_buffer(p1_handle, (x0, 16), strides=(16, 1))
    p2 = T.match_buffer(p2_handle, (x0,), strides=(1,))
    p3 = T.match_buffer(p3_handle, (x0,), strides=(1,))
    # with T.block("root"):
    bx = T.launch_thread("blockIdx.x", x0)
    tx = T.launch_thread("threadIdx.x", 128)
    ty = T.launch_thread("threadIdx.y", 1)
    tz = T.launch_thread("threadIdx.z", 1)
    with T.block("tilelang_root"):
        T.reads(p0[bx, 0], p2[bx], p3[bx], p1[bx, 0])
        T.writes()
        row = T.alloc_buffer((16,), scope="local.fragment")
        row_max = T.alloc_buffer((1,), scope="local.fragment")
        row_exp = T.alloc_buffer((16,), scope="local.fragment")
        row_sum = T.alloc_buffer((1,), scope="local.fragment")
        T.copy(T.region(p0[bx, 0], 1, 1, 16), T.region(row[0], 2, 16))
        T.reduce(row[0:16], row_max[0], "max", 0, T.bool(True))
        max_value: T.float32 = row_max[0]
        T.copy(T.region(row_max[0], 1, 1), T.region(p2[bx], 2, 1))
        for v6 in T.parallel(16):
            row_exp[v6] = T.exp(row[v6] - max_value)
        T.reduce(row_exp[0:16], row_sum[0], "sum", 0, T.bool(True))
        sum_value: T.float32 = row_sum[0]
        T.copy(T.region(row_sum[0], 1, 1), T.region(p3[bx], 2, 1))
        for v6 in T.parallel(16):
            row_exp[v6] = row_exp[v6] / sum_value
        T.copy(T.region(row_exp[0], 1, 16), T.region(p1[bx, 0], 2, 1, 16))

# from tvm.script import tir as T

@T.prim_func
def main(input_ptr_handle: T.handle, output_ptr_handle: T.handle, row_max_ptr_handle: T.handle, row_sum_ptr_handle: T.handle):
    M = T.int32()
    input_ptr = T.match_buffer(input_ptr_handle, (M, 16), strides=(16, 1))
    output_ptr = T.match_buffer(output_ptr_handle, (M, 16), strides=(16, 1))
    row_max_ptr = T.match_buffer(row_max_ptr_handle, (M,), strides=(1,))
    row_sum_ptr = T.match_buffer(row_sum_ptr_handle, (M,), strides=(1,))
    # with T.block("root"):
    bx = T.launch_thread("blockIdx.x", M)
    tx = T.launch_thread("threadIdx.x", 128)
    ty = T.launch_thread("threadIdx.y", 1)
    tz = T.launch_thread("threadIdx.z", 1)
    with T.block("tilelang_root"):
        T.reads(input_ptr[bx, 0:16])
        T.writes(row_max_ptr[bx], row_sum_ptr[bx], output_ptr[bx, 0:16])
        row = T.alloc_buffer((16,), scope="local.fragment")
        mx = T.alloc_buffer((1,), scope="local.fragment")
        exp_row = T.alloc_buffer((16,), scope="local.fragment")
        sm = T.alloc_buffer((1,), scope="local.fragment")
        out_row = T.alloc_buffer((16,), scope="local.fragment")
        for r in range(16):
            row[r] = input_ptr[bx, r]
        T.reduce(row[0:16], mx[0], "max", 0, T.bool(True))
        row_max_ptr[bx] = mx[0]
        for r in range(16):
            exp_row[r] = T.exp(row[r] - mx[0])
        T.reduce(exp_row[0:16], sm[0], "sum", 0, T.bool(True))
        row_sum_ptr[bx] = sm[0]
        for r in range(16):
            out_row[r] = exp_row[r] / sm[0]
        for r in range(16):
            output_ptr[bx, r] = out_row[r]
